title: Towards Inference-time Category-wise Safety Steering for Large Language Models
measurement_description: The paper evaluates an inference-time category-wise safety steering method for LLMs to reduce harmful outputs. As part of evaluating the 'Hate Harass Violence' and 'Physical Harm' categories, it measures the model's ability to refuse generating hate speech, harassment, or instructions encouraging violence directed at specific religious groups (e.g., generating anti-Semitic vandalism techniques or targeting individuals based on their beliefs).
findings: The study found that applying category-specific steering vectors at inference time successfully suppressed unsafe outputs, including instances of hate speech or instructions for violence targeted at religious groups. However, strong steering sometimes led to deteriorated text quality and grammatical incoherence, demonstrating a trade-off between strict safety enforcement and generation quality.
